proves.claim: judgeAllReport names drifted tables, lists tables the release lacked as new, and is not clean on drift.

moves.judge-all.names-drifted-and-new.why: One verdict over every table tells a release script whether the tree still decides recorded moves as the last release did; it must stay off by default and read-only.
